data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Instabug crash, bug, performance monitoring and in‑app feedback
data.what_it_does: Instabug provides crash reporting, bug reporting, performance monitoring, in‑app replies, surveys and feature requests for Flutter apps.
use_when: When you need integrated crash and bug reporting
When you want in‑app feedback and surveys
avoid_when: When you only need basic crash reporting
weaknesses: Requires Instabug account and SDK token
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, run flutter packages get, initialize Instabug in main, add iOS permissions for microphone and photo library
